pairs.target: pà wò bǎ fēngzheng dàidào cǎopō shàng shí , suǒyǒurén dōu xiān kànjiàn le nà zhāng liǎn .
pairs.english: When Pavo brought his kite onto the grassy slope, everyone noticed the face first.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃把风筝带到草坡上时，所有人都先看见了那张脸。

pairs.target: liǎngtiáo méimáo shì yòng xiéshuā huà de , yìgāoyìdī .
pairs.english: Its eyebrows had been painted with a shoe brush, one higher than the other.
pairs.hanzi: 两条眉毛是用鞋刷画的，一高一低。

pairs.target: zuǐ shì yíkuài méi tú yún de hóngzhǐ , fēng yì chuī , zhǐbiān fān qǐ , xiàng zài chōng rén tǔshétou .
pairs.english: The mouth was unevenly painted red paper; when the wind lifted its edge, it seemed to stick out its tongue.
pairs.hanzi: 嘴是一块没涂匀的红纸，风一吹，纸边翻起，像在冲人吐舌头。

pairs.target: " zhè shì nǐ ? " yīwén wèn . " zhè shì nǐ fù bù qǐ qián de zhàizhǔ . "
pairs.english: “Is that you?” Iven asked. “It's the creditor you can't afford to pay.”
pairs.hanzi:
“这是你？”伊文问。
“这是你付不起钱的债主。”

pairs.target: sū yǐ xiào dé bǎ xiànzhóu diào zài dìshàng .
pairs.english: Suyi laughed so hard she dropped her reel.
pairs.hanzi: 苏苡笑得把线轴掉在地上。

pairs.target: mǐlā méi xiào , zhèng dūn zhe xiū tāmen de shuāngwěi fēngzheng , yìtiáo wěiba jiǎn dé bǐ lìng yìtiáo zhǎi , shì yǒuyì de .
pairs.english: Mira wasn't laughing; she was crouched repairing their twin-tailed kite, with one tail deliberately narrower than the other.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉没笑，正蹲着修她们的双尾风筝，一条尾巴剪得比另一条窄，是有意的。

pairs.target: pō shàng méiyǒu guīdìng shuí fēi dé gāo jiù yíng ;
pairs.english: There was no rule on the slope that the highest kite won;
pairs.hanzi: 坡上没有规定谁飞得高就赢；

pairs.target: cānjiā de rén xiān gè fàng yìméi tóngpiàn zài wǎn lǐ ,
pairs.english: each participant first put a copper piece into a bowl,
pairs.hanzi: 参加的人先各放一枚铜片在碗里，

pairs.target: shuí de fēngzheng zài kōngzhōng liú dào yuēdìng de zhōng shēngxiǎng , biàn yìqǐ fēn mǎilái de táng bǐng .
pairs.english: and anyone whose kite stayed aloft until the agreed bell would share the bought sugar cakes.
pairs.hanzi: 谁的风筝在空中留到约定的钟声响，便一起分买来的糖饼。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi juéde guījǔ hěn piányi , děng kànjiàn táng bǐng tānqián nàtiáo duì , cái zhīdào hái déchū yígè páiduì de rén .
pairs.english: Tavi thought the terms were cheap, until the queue at the cake stall showed him someone also had to stand in line.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维觉得规矩很便宜，等看见糖饼摊前那条队，才知道还得出一个排队的人。

pairs.target: tāmen chōu cǎo jīng .
pairs.english: They drew grass stems.
pairs.hanzi: 他们抽草茎。

pairs.target: yīwén chōu dào zuì duǎn de , lìkè yāoqiú zhòng chōu ,
pairs.english: Iven drew the shortest and immediately demanded another draw,
pairs.hanzi: 伊文抽到最短的，立刻要求重抽，

pairs.target: lǐyóu shì tǎ wéi tiāo cǎo de yǎnguāng tàihǎole , suàn dé shàng zuòbì .
pairs.english: arguing that Tavi's eye for grass was so good it counted as cheating.
pairs.hanzi: 理由是塔维挑草的眼光太好了，算得上作弊。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ lìngwài sāngēn tānkāi gěi tā kàn , chángdù jīhū yìmúyíyàng .
pairs.english: Tavi spread out the other three for him; they were almost identical in length.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把另外三根摊开给他看，长度几乎一模一样。

pairs.target: " nǐ lián zuòbì dōu búhuì . " yīwén zhuāqǐ wǎn zǒu le .
pairs.english: “You can't even cheat.” Iven snatched up the bowl and left.
pairs.hanzi: “你连作弊都不会。”伊文抓起碗走了。

pairs.target: zhè piàn cǎopō zài xuégōng xīqiáng lǐ , xiàmiàn jiùshì shàiyī chǎng .
pairs.english: This grassy slope was inside the academy's western wall, directly above the drying yard.
pairs.hanzi: 这片草坡在学宫西墙里，下面就是晒衣场。

pairs.target: kàn chǎng de rén zǎo bǎ gāo shéng shōuqǐ , zhī liúxià liǎnggēn tū mùzhuāng , miǎnde xiàn chán shàng .
pairs.english: The yard attendant had already taken down the high lines, leaving two bare posts so kite strings wouldn't tangle.
pairs.hanzi: 看场的人早把高绳收起，只留下两根秃木桩，免得线缠上。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bāng pà wò jǔ zhe fēngzheng , shǒuzhǒu gāo guòtóu , děng yízhènfēng cóng qiáng quēkǒu guòlái .
pairs.english: Tavi held up Pavo's kite with elbows above his head, waiting for a gust through the gap in the wall.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维帮帕沃举着风筝，手肘高过头，等一阵风从墙缺口过来。

pairs.target: " pǎo ! " tā pǎo le , pà wò yě pǎo le , fēngzheng què méi pǎo .
pairs.english: “Run!” He ran. Pavo ran too. The kite did not.
pairs.hanzi:
“跑！”
他跑了，帕沃也跑了，风筝却没跑。

pairs.target: nà zhāng zhàizhǔ de liǎn fān le gè gēntou , pūjìn cǎo lǐ .
pairs.english: The creditor's face somersaulted into the grass.
pairs.hanzi: 那张债主的脸翻了个跟头，扑进草里。

pairs.target: sū yǐ guìxià lái jiǎnchá , fājué héng zhú bèi shuā méimáo de shuǐpào wān le , zuǒyòu yǐjīng bùpíng .
pairs.english: Suyi knelt to inspect it and found that water from painting the eyebrows had warped the crosspiece of bamboo, making the sides uneven.
pairs.hanzi: 苏苡跪下来检查，发觉横竹被刷眉毛的水泡弯了，左右已经不平。

pairs.target: pà wò bùkěn xièdiào liǎn , zuìhòu jiǎn qù yìxiǎopiàn zuǐjiǎo , lìng jiē le tiáo wěiba .
pairs.english: Pavo refused to remove the face; they finally cut off a little corner of the mouth and added another tail.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃不肯卸掉脸，最后剪去一小片嘴角，另接了条尾巴。

pairs.target: zhàizhǔ xiǎnde gèng jiānsuān , dǎo zhōngyú yáoyáohuànghuàng dìshàng le tiān .
pairs.english: The creditor looked more sour, but at last wobbled into the sky.
pairs.hanzi: 债主显得更尖酸，倒终于摇摇晃晃地上了天。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào dé fùbù fāsuān , lún dào zìjǐ wò xiànzhóu shí hái zài xiào .
pairs.english: Tavi laughed until his stomach ached, and was still laughing when his turn to hold the reel came.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑得腹部发酸，轮到自己握线轴时还在笑。

pairs.target: fēngzheng de lìqi hūrán chuánguòlái , shùnzhe xiàn chě zhe tā de shǒu .
pairs.english: The kite's force suddenly travelled down the line, tugging his hand.
pairs.hanzi: 风筝的力气忽然传过来，顺着线扯着他的手。

pairs.target: tā běnnéng dì hòutuì yíbù , sū yǐ gǎnjǐn jiào tā bié wǎng mùzhuāng nàbiān zǒu .
pairs.english: Instinctively he stepped back; Suyi quickly warned him away from the posts.
pairs.hanzi: 他本能地后退一步，苏苡赶紧叫他别往木桩那边走。

pairs.target: nà búshì tiěpiàn zài zhǐ xià de yìdiǎn biànhuà .
pairs.english: This wasn't a slight change in iron beneath his fingers.
pairs.hanzi: 那不是铁片在指下的一点变化。

pairs.target: tiānkōng lǐ yǒu gè chǒu dōngxī , gé zhe nàme yuǎn , réng néng qīngqīngchǔchǔ dìlā tā yíxià .
pairs.english: There was an ugly thing in the sky, so far away, yet its tug reached him distinctly.
pairs.hanzi: 天空里有个丑东西，隔着那么远，仍能清清楚楚地拉他一下。

pairs.target: tā táitóu , zhídào bózisuān le , cái kěn bǎ xiànzhóu háigěi pà wò .
pairs.english: He gazed up until his neck hurt before surrendering the reel to Pavo.
pairs.hanzi: 他抬头，直到脖子酸了，才肯把线轴还给帕沃。

pairs.target: yīwén tí zhe zhǐbāo huílái , liǎnshàng yǒu hàn .
pairs.english: Iven returned with a paper parcel and a sweaty face.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文提着纸包回来，脸上有汗。

pairs.target: táng bǐng shǎo le yìxiǎo jiǎo , shuō shì tānzhǔ qiè lái gěi tā yàn wèi de ,
pairs.english: A small corner of cake was missing; he said the seller had cut it for him to taste.
pairs.hanzi: 糖饼少了一小角，说是摊主切来给他验味的，

pairs.target: mǐlā bú xìn , què máng zhe shōuxiàn , méikòng shěn tā .
pairs.english: Mira didn't believe him, but was too busy winding in her line to question him.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉不信，却忙着收线，没空审他。

pairs.target: " xiūkè de shíhòu qù hébiān ba . " tā shuō ,
pairs.english: “Let's go to the river during the break,” she said.
pairs.hanzi: “休课的时候去河边吧。”她说，

pairs.target: " wǒ hé sū yǐ xiǎng kànkàn xiàyóu nàge zuò chuánmó de tān . "
pairs.english: “Suyi and I want to see that model-boat stall downstream.”
pairs.hanzi: “我和苏苡想看看下游那个做船模的摊。”

pairs.target: " nǎ cì xiūkè ? " yīwén wèn . " chángxiū . búshì míngtiān . "
pairs.english: “Which break?” Iven asked. “The long one. Not tomorrow.”
pairs.hanzi:
“哪次休课？”伊文问。
“长休。不是明天。”

pairs.target: yī wénjiě zhǐbāo de shǒu tíng le tíng .
pairs.english: Iven paused in unwrapping the parcel.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文解纸包的手停了停。

pairs.target: tā yǐjīng dāying fùqīn , chángxiū qiánbànduàn qù shuǐlù gōngshǔ bāng zhe héduì dìtú .
pairs.english: He'd already promised his father to help check maps at the waterways office during the first half of the long break.
pairs.hanzi: 他已经答应父亲，长休前半段去水路公署帮着核对地图。

pairs.target: shàngwǔ shōudào quèrènxìn , lián yào dài nǎ jǐběn cèzǐ dōu liè hǎo le .
pairs.english: The confirmation letter that morning even listed which booklets to bring.
pairs.hanzi: 上午收到确认信，连要带哪几本册子都列好了。

pairs.target: mǐlā bǎ xiàn duō rào le liǎngquān . " nǐ zǎoshàng búshì shuō yǒukōng ? "
pairs.english: Mira wound two more turns of the line. “Didn't you say this morning that you were free?”
pairs.hanzi: 米拉把线多绕了两圈。“你早上不是说有空？”

pairs.target: " wǒ shuō jīntiān . "
pairs.english: “I said today.”
pairs.hanzi: “我说今天。”

pairs.target: tā hái xiǎng zhēng , xiǎng le xiǎng , quèshí shì zìjǐ bǎ liǎngjiànshì hùn zài le yìqǐ .
pairs.english: She wanted to argue, then realized she had indeed mixed the two things up.
pairs.hanzi: 她还想争，想了想，确实是自己把两件事混在了一起。

pairs.target: tā bùgāoxìngdì bǎ xiànzhóu dìgěi sū yǐ , shuō nà jiù lìng tiāo rìzi ,
pairs.english: Unhappily handing the reel to Suyi, she said they'd choose another day;
pairs.hanzi: 她不高兴地把线轴递给苏苡，说那就另挑日子，

pairs.target: zìjǐ bùnéng bǎ zhěnggè chángxiū dōu liúkōng , fùqīn hái děng tā huíqù .
pairs.english: she couldn't leave the entire long break free, since her father was expecting her home.
pairs.hanzi: 自己不能把整个长休都留空，父亲还等她回去。

alignment.english: leave the entire long break free

pairs.target: tǎ wéi méi chāhuà .
pairs.english: Tavi didn't interrupt.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维没插话。

pairs.target: tā běnlái yě xiǎng huí huī ào , rújīn nà fēng gěi sè lā de xìn yǐjīng yǒu le huíyīn , gèng xiǎng dāngmiàn liáoliáo .
pairs.english: He'd wanted to return to Ash Hollow too; now that his letter to Sela had an answer, he wanted even more to talk in person.
pairs.hanzi: 他本来也想回灰坳，如今那封给瑟拉的信已经有了回音，更想当面聊聊。

pairs.target: xìn jìchū hòu de dìqītiān , yě jiùshì zuótiān , ménfáng bǎ huíxìn dìgěi tā .
pairs.english: On the seventh day after posting it—yesterday—the gatekeeper had handed him the reply.
pairs.hanzi: 信寄出后的第七天，也就是昨天，门房把回信递给他。

pairs.target: sè lā shuō huì hé bó yà àn nànián de dōng méi zhàng mànmàn suàn ,
pairs.english: Sela said she and Boya would work it out slowly using that year's winter coal accounts,
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉说会和博娅按那年的冬煤账慢慢算，

pairs.target: yòu shuō bié bǎ tā jìbùqīng de shì , tì tā xiěchéng jìde qīng .
pairs.english: and told him not to write the things she recalled uncertainly as though she remembered them clearly.
pairs.hanzi: 又说别把她记不清的事，替她写成记得清。

pairs.target: zuìhòu yìháng shì : zhǎodào shuí jiù xiě huílái , méi zhǎodào yě xiě . nǐ nà zhī lán wǎn wǒ méi sòng rén .
pairs.english: The last line said: Write back if you find someone, and if you don't. I haven't given away your blue bowl.
pairs.hanzi: 最后一行是：找到谁就写回来，没找到也写。你那只蓝碗我没送人。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dú de shíhòu xiào le , hòulái què bǎ zhǐ zhé dé tèbié zǐxì .
pairs.english: Tavi smiled reading it, but afterwards folded the paper with particular care.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维读的时候笑了，后来却把纸折得特别仔细。

pairs.target: pō shàng de zhōngshēng dào le .
pairs.english: The bell sounded over the slope.
pairs.hanzi: 坡上的钟声到了。

pairs.target: mǐlā hé sū yǐ de shuāngwěi hái zài tiānshàng ,
pairs.english: Mira and Suyi's twin tails were still in the sky,
pairs.hanzi: 米拉和苏苡的双尾还在天上，

pairs.target: zhàizhǔ què gānghǎo zāixiàqù , liǎn cháo xià guà zài mùzhuāng shàng .
pairs.english: but the creditor had just plunged, hanging face down on a post.
pairs.hanzi: 债主却刚好栽下去，脸朝下挂在木桩上。

pairs.target: pà wò yāoqiú suàn shàng tā luòdì qián hái zài fēi de nà bànshēng zhōng .
pairs.english: Pavo demanded credit for the half-chime it had still been flying before landing.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃要求算上它落地前还在飞的那半声钟。

pairs.target: qíyú rén yìbiān fǎnduì , yìbiān bǎ táng bǐng sāi gěi tā .
pairs.english: The others protested while stuffing sugar cakes into his hands.
pairs.hanzi: 其余人一边反对，一边把糖饼塞给他。

pairs.target: tāmen zuò dào cǎo lǐ chī .
pairs.english: They sat in the grass to eat.
pairs.hanzi: 他们坐到草里吃。

pairs.target: yīwén sīxià zhǐbāo zuì wàimiàn gānjìng de yìtiáo , xiě le zìjǐ yǒukōng de jǐtiān , dìgěi mǐlā .
pairs.english: Iven tore a clean strip from the outside of the wrapper, wrote his free days on it, and passed it to Mira.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文撕下纸包最外面干净的一条，写了自己有空的几天，递给米拉。

pairs.target: tā cāgān shǒuzhǐ , yě tiān le liǎnggè rìzi .
pairs.english: She dried her fingers and added two dates.
pairs.hanzi: 她擦干手指，也添了两个日子。

pairs.target: zuìhòu zhǐtiáo dào le tǎ wéi shǒulǐ .
pairs.english: Finally the strip reached Tavi.
pairs.hanzi: 最后纸条到了塔维手里。

pairs.target: tā de zhǐ fù hái jì zhe xiànzhóu de lè hén , xiězì yǒudiǎn wāi .
pairs.english: His fingertips still remembered the pressure of the reel, making his writing crooked.
pairs.hanzi: 他的指腹还记着线轴的勒痕，写字有点歪。

pairs.target: tā quān le yígè sāngè rén dōu kōng zhe de rìzi , zài pángbiān tiān shàng " hébiān ", yòu bǎ zhǐ chuán huíqù .
pairs.english: He circled a day all three had free, added “Riverside” beside it, and passed the paper back.
pairs.hanzi: 他圈了一个三个人都空着的日子，在旁边添上“河边”，又把纸传回去。
